newsitem.title: UK: Volex sees continued earnings growth.
newsitem.headline: Volex sees continued earnings growth.

text.p: British connector and cable assemblies company Volex Group Plc said on Tuesday it expected continued earnings growth, helped by growing demand for worldwide telecommunications and data networks.
Volex said the favourable market conditions and its partnerships with leading telecoms manufacturers were expected to strengthen its position.

"These opportunities...provide the conditions for us to continue a sustainable growth in profits and earnings. The new financial year has started well and we look forward to another year of solid progress," the company said in a statement.
Volex earlier on Tuesday announced a 13 percent rise in annual pre-tax profits to 14.4 million.
